findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_form, flatten_pdf · Private data: get_usage, create_form, fill_form_from_context, prepare_form, commit_proposal, get_proposal, read_form, add_attachment, merge_pdf, inspect_pdf · Public sink: find_form, get_usage, create_form, send_fax · Destructive: delete_form, get_batch, delete_pages, flatten_pdf.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_form, flatten_pdf · Private data: get_usage, create_form, fill_form_from_context, prepare_form, commit_proposal, get_proposal, read_form, add_attachment, merge_pdf, inspect_pdf · Public sink: find_form, get_usage, create_form, send_fax · Destructive: delete_form, get_batch, delete_pages, flatten_pdf

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
